title: Learning Gait Representation from Massive Unlabelled Walking Videos: A Benchmark
reasoning: Section 7, "ETHICAL STATEMENTS", extensively discusses the ethical implications of gait recognition, particularly concerning personal privacy when collecting massive unlabelled data. It outlines an "ethical conundrum" and details specific measures (Data Minimization, Expiration Date, Opt-out, Unattended Pre-treatment, Reasonable Anonymization, Purpose Limitation, Ethical Requirements) taken to protect individuals, going beyond a brief disclaimer.
